messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: perturbed affine image of a triangular lattice

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration is a perturbed affine image of a 13-point hexagonal patch of the triangular lattice (a central point plus two hexagonal rings), scaled to touch the unit square boundary at its extreme vertices and sheared so that the patch's six extreme points lie on the square's perimeter. This perturbed affine image achieves a minimum triangle area of 2/45 ≈ 0.04444, with the minimum-area triangles occurring among triples involving the boundary and near-boundary lattice points. The affine degrees of freedom (aspect ratio and shear) are tuned so that the four smallest fundamental triangles of the hexagonal patch become equal in area, maximizing the bottleneck."}
